title: Salik Recharge: Different Ways to Recharge Salik in Dubai
description: Need to top up your Salik account? Our guide covers all the methods for a quick Salik recharge, from using the official app and websites.

breadcrumb.name: Salik Recharge: Different Ways to Recharge Salik in Dubai

contentHtml:
The Dubai Roads and Transport Authority established Salik, Dubai’s electronic toll gate system. It is essential for maintaining smooth traffic flow across the region. Whether you are a resident managing everyday commutes or a guest visiting Dubai’s landmarks, a complete understanding of Salik Dubai is required since this system not only optimizes traffic control but also lowers traffic jams and improves transport.

Commuters must fill up their Salik accounts on a regular basis to keep everything working efficiently. This blog gives a complete overview of the procedure to recharge your Salik account utilizing multiple online and offline Salik recharge options, assuring both convenience and effectiveness.

Explore Easy Methods to Recharge the Dubai Salik Account

Salik Dubai is one of the most significant plans for alleviating traffic jams on the highways. However, the project would not have been as successful if the identical simplicity of use had not extended to the means offered to Salik to recharge. There are many possibilities for commuters in Dubai to recharge their Salik accounts, ensuring a smooth process.

Salik accounts may be recharged using a specific Salik card or a credit card. Certain platforms allow both, while others only take one payment method. You may upgrade your Dubai Salik account in any of the following ways for your convenience:

    • Salik Dubai Helpline and Customer Care
    • Mobile SMS Service 
    • Cash Deposit and Self-Service Machines
    • Bank Credit Cards and ATMs 
    • Salik Official Website
    • Salik Android App
    • RTA Dubai Drive App
    • Dubai Now Mobile App 
    • Salik recharge by plate number

Recharging the Dubai Salik Account with Phone Call and SMS 

Call Salik support for assistance to add an amount to your Salik recharge card. Here are a few steps you need to take for the Salik recharge:

  • Scratch the stripe to reveal the concealed twelve-digit recharge code on the backside of the Salik card.
  • Call the Salik Helpline for assistance
  • Select your language to continue 
  • Enter the recharge code as instructed by the electronic system. 
  • After a successful upgrade, your mobile device will get a confirmation alert with updated credit information. 

Recharging Dubai Salik Account with Self-Service Machines

Salik self-service devices are located around Dubai. There is a Smart Drive App that allows you to navigate to the proper spot. Once you arrive at the self-service machine, you are required to log in with your registered username and password, tap on the Recharge option, and make a cash deposit into your account. Your Salik account will be charged after the reload procedure is completed.

Recharging the Dubai Salik Account with the Bank and ATMs

Banks in Dubai provide a range of recharge options to help Salik consumers. ATM, SMS, mobile banking, website, and Android apps are all recharge methods. Furthermore, Salik’s self-service devices have been placed in certain locations. A few banks also provide automatic additions to Salik accounts. However, you must confirm with the bank whether this service is available to them.

Dubai Salik Account Recharge through Online Portals

There are two efficient options for Salik recharge online in Dubai. You can load credit to your account using the online web portal or the smartphone app. You may recharge your Salik account using the following applications: The Salik Smart Phone App, the RTA Dubai Driving App, and the Dubai Now Smarter App. These alternatives allow you to fill your Salik account from anywhere, at any moment.

You can refill your Salik account online with a credit card or by entering the Salik reload card details into the Salik Recharge Gateway. You need to follow these steps to recharge Salik by credit card: 

  • Join the Salik Web Portal 
  • Select Salik Services, then My Tag, then the Recharge option.
  • Select a recharging procedure, such as Online Payment
  • Enter login information: Cell phone number, Territory, Emirates, Type, Plate Code, and Value. 
  • Select the amount of money you want to credit, and select the Next option. 
  • Enter the credit card code along with the required payment details. 
  • After a successful refill, you will be transferred to the confirmation webpage. 
  • If you want to make payments using the rechargeable card number, follow these steps:
  • Log in to the Salik web portal 
  • Select Salik Services, then My Tag, and Recharge. 
  • Select a recharging method, Reload Code: 
  • Enter login information: Cell phone number, Emirate, Type, Plate Code, and Value. 
  • Enter your recharge card code. 
  • Press Recharge Option 
  • When the upgrade is successful, you will be sent to a confirmation screen. 

Dubai Salik Account Recharge Using Smart Android App

The Smart Salik application is a useful tool that allows users to execute all Salik account-related functions easily. You may use the mobile application to Salik recharge in Dubai by entering a credit card or reload card information. Smart Salik App provides both alternatives for loading up your account. These are the procedures to take using a refill card number: 

  • Install the Smart Salik Application. 
  • Sign up with your login number and PIN code. 
  • Log in and select Reload as the payment option.
  • Enter the reload card info or verify the code using the camera icon. 
  • Following a successful refill, the screen will display a notification with your new salik balance. 

You can reload with a credit card using the Salik app: 

  • Download the Smart Salik Application. 
  • Sign up with the account information and PIN code. 
  • Log in and select the Online Payment method. 
  • Enter the sum in multiples of fifty only. 
  • Enter payment card information and tap the Done option. 
  • A screen will display, indicating the successful refilling of the Salik account.

Essential Tips for Dubai Salik Account Maintenance

To guarantee seamless travel and prevent any unexpected penalties in Dubai, keep these key considerations in mind when handling your Salik account:
Verify your Salik status periodically to ensure you have sufficient credit before passing through toll gates. 

  • If you pass through a toll gate with insufficient cash, you may face an AED fee.
  • Attempt to replenish your Salik account within five business days following your last toll passage. 
  • Neglecting to do so leads to an everyday penalty of 50 (fifty) AED until your Salik account is restored. 

Final Words

It is suggested that you keep an eye on your Salik account before it runs out of the credits required for crossing toll gates. By following these rules, you may avoid paying excessive fees and maintain your Salik account in excellent condition. FAQs for Salik Recharge

What payment methods are available for Salik account recharge?

You can recharge via credit card, Salik recharge cards, ATMs, bank apps, self-service machines, or official online portals.

How can I recharge my Salik account via SMS or phone call?

Simply scratch your Salik card, call the helpline, follow instructions, enter the code, and you’ll get confirmation.

Can I recharge Salik using the RTA or Dubai Now apps?

RTA Dubai Drive and Dubai Now apps both let you top up anytime using a card or recharge code.

What happens if I drive through a toll gate with insufficient Salik balance?

You’ll face a 50 Dirhams daily fine until the account is recharged, on top of the unpaid toll.

How long do I have to recharge Salik after passing a toll to avoid fines?

You have 5 business days to top up your account. If you miss it, you have to pay the 50 Dirhams penalty.
